# Cumulative price index growth over standard windows

<!-- Generated by scripts/document_methodologies.py from v*.yaml. Do not edit. -->

**Id:** `index_growth`  
**Owner:** Housing Market Insights  
**Versions:** v1 (approved)

## Answers questions like
- how did prices grow over the last N years
- price growth in <place> since <year>
- how much have house prices risen
- Preisentwicklung der letzten 5 Jahre

## Inputs
| Parameter | Allowed values | Default | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `geography` | `AD02`, `AD04`, `AD05`, `AD06`, `AD08` |  | yes |
| `window` | `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `YTD`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`, `5y`, `all` | `5y` |  |
| `item` | `house`, `apartment`, `hybrid` | `hybrid` |  |
| `transaction` | `TRANSACTION_TYPE.SELL`, `TRANSACTION_TYPE.RENT` | `TRANSACTION_TYPE.SELL` |  |

## Sources
- `SILVER_PROD.MKKN_INDICE.INDICE_DE`
- `SILVER_PROD.GEOR_GEOREF.GEO_PLACE`

## Implementation
- **function:** `housing_germany.indices.functions.build_index_series`
- **then:** `housing_germany.indices.functions.variation_windows`

## Fixed calculation choices
These cannot be changed per request; changing them requires a new version.

- **metric:** METRIC.SQM_PRICE
- **index_version:** latest RECORD_TS per place and item
- **hybrid_build:** house + apartment rebased to their common start date
- **hybrid_source:** computed, never read from INDICE_DE ITEM_TYPE.HYBRID (no longer published since 2026-10)
- **hybrid_weights:** housing stock (STATS.DE.MA.HOUSING.APARTMENT_COUNT / HOUSE_COUNT); last transaction volume when the count is missing or 0
- **window_anchor:** latest index date; past value = last observation at or before the anchor minus window
- **ytd_base:** December of the previous year

## Outputs
- Table: `HOUSING_DEV.MARKET_INSIGHTS_STREAMLIT_APPS.MARKET_SUMMARY`
- Grain: `PLACE_ID`, `PLACE_TYPE`, `TRANSACTION_TYPE`, `ITEM_TYPE`
- Columns: `VAR_1M`, `VAR_3M`, `VAR_6M`, `VAR_YTD`, `VAR_1Y`, `VAR_2Y`, `VAR_3Y`, `VAR_5Y`, `VAR_ALL`

## Quality checks
- `not_empty`
- `range`: column=VAR_1Y, min=-0.5, max=1.0
- `range`: column=VAR_5Y, min=-0.6, max=1.5
- `completeness`: column=VAR_1Y, min_share_non_null=0.9
- `max_delta_vs_previous_run`: column=VAR_1Y, max_abs=0.05
- `golden`: test=apps/housing_dashboard/validate_harmonization.py

## Open questions
- The current TASK_REFRESH_MARKET_SUMMARY computes windows in SQL on the stored ITEM_TYPE.HYBRID series and with exact-date joins (no fallback to the previous observation). This spec defines the package implementation as canonical. The size of the difference has not been measured yet; measure it before switching MARKET_SUMMARY to the new pipeline. The refresh pipeline records this on every run (drift_probe -> ISSUES kind 'drift').
- YTD base differs: MARKET_SUMMARY uses January of the current year (DATE_TRUNC('year')), the package uses December of the previous year.
